text:
🚀 Connect your communication app to AI in just one minute

 
 
 
 
 

 

 MuseBot

This repository provides a Chat bot (Telegram, Discord, Slack, Lark（飞书），钉钉, 企业微信, QQ, 微信) that integrates
with LLM API to provide
AI-powered responses. The bot supports openai deepseek gemini LLMs, making interactions feel
more natural and dynamic. 
中文文档 
Китайская документация

 Thanks

感谢阮一峰老师的weekly，很荣幸能登榜： 
感谢linux.do 社区，佬友们很给力，给一个我的介绍贴链接： 
Thanks to the Reddit community as well, even though a few of my subreddits got banned 😅: 

 🚀 Features

- 🤖 AI Responses : Uses LLM API for chatbot replies.
- ⏳ Streaming Output : Sends responses in real-time to improve user experience.
- 🧠 Long-term Memory : remembers user facts across conversations and injects them into context; accumulated history
 auto-compresses when it grows too long, see advanced config.
- 💬 Chat Experience : typing indicator while the LLM generates and message reactions on completion (supported platforms).
- 🏗 Easy Deployment : Run locally or deploy to a cloud server.
- 👀 Identify Image : use image to communicate with LLM,
 see doc.
- 📄 Identify Document : send txt/pdf/csv/html documents and ask questions; chat media is stored
 locally per conversation, see doc.
- 🎺 Support Voice : use voice to communicate with LLM,
 see doc.
- 🐂 Function Call : transform mcp protocol to function call,
 see doc.
- 🧩 Skills : load local SKILL.md instructions into the unified /task workflow,
 see doc.
- 🛠️ Conversational System Operations : inside the /task workflow, manage runtime settings, MCP, skills, and cron jobs, and run commands and file operations inside safety boundaries,
 see doc.
- 🌊 RAG : Support Rag to fill context,
 see doc.
- 🌞 AdminPlatform : Use platform to manage MuseBot,
 see doc.
- 🌛 Register : With the service registration module, robot instances can be automatically registered to the
 registration center doc
- 🧩 Plugins : Wire up new LLM providers and chat channels through the provider / channel registries — one file per
 extension, see doc
- 🛟 Model-layer resilience : automatically fail over from the primary model to other configured providers, and route
 internal calls to a cheap utility model, see doc
- 🌈 Metrics : Support Metrics for monitoring,
 see doc.
- 🐶 Cron : Support Cron to trigger LLM,
 see doc.

 📸 Support Platform

 Platform Supported Description Docs / Links 
 ---------------------- :---------: ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 🟦 Telegram ✅ Supports Telegram bot (go-telegram-bot-api based, handles commands, inline buttons, ForceReply, etc.) Docs 
 🌈 Discord ✅ Supports Discord bot Docs 
 🌛 Web API ✅ Provides HTTP/Web API for interacting with LLM (great for custom frontends/backends) Docs 
 🔷 Slack ✅ Supports Slack (Socket Mode / Events API / Block Kit interactions) Docs 
 🟣 Lark (Feishu) ✅ Supports Lark long connection & message handling (based on larksuite SDK, with image/audio download & message update) Docs 
 🆙 DingDing ✅ Supports Dingding long connection Docs 
 ⚡️ Work WeChat ✅ Support Work WeChat http callback to trigger LLM Docs 
 🌞 QQ ✅ Support QQ http callback to trigger LLM Docs 
 🚇 Wechat ✅ Support Wechat http callback to trigger LLM Docs 

 Supported Large Language Models

 NOTE : All providers are accessed through the OpenAI-compatible API format (chat completions, images, audio).
 Aliyun (Qwen) and Vol (Doubao) are the recommended/fully-supported providers. Third-party relay
 services (OpenRouter / OrcaRouter / 302.AI) have been removed.

 ⚙️ Configuration

You can configure the bot via environment variables:

Here’s the English version of your environment variable table:
If you use parameter. Please use lower letter and underscore. for example: ./MuseBot -telegram bot token=xxx

 Variable Name Description Default Value 
 --------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------

 DISCORD BOT TOKEN Discord bot token - 
 SLACK BOT TOKEN Slack bot token - 
 SLACK APP TOKEN Slack app-level token - 
 LARK APP ID Lark (Feishu) App ID - 
 LARK APP SECRET Lark (Feishu) App Secret - 
 DING CLIENT ID DingTalk App Key / Client ID - 
 DING CLIENT SECRET DingTalk App Secret - 
 COM WECHAT TOKEN WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) token - 
 COM WECHAT ENCODING AES KEY WeCom EncodingAESKey - 
 COM WECHAT CORP ID WeCom CorpID - 
 COM WECHAT SECRET WeCom App Secret - 
 COM WECHAT AGENT ID WeCom Agent ID - 
 WECHAT APP ID WeChat Official Account AppID - 
 WECHAT APP SECRET WeChat Official Account AppSecret - 
 WECHAT ENCODING AES KEY WeChat Official Account EncodingAESKey - 
 WECHAT TOKEN WeChat Official Account Token - 
 WECHAT ACTIVE Whether to enable WeChat message listening (true/false) false 
 QQ APP ID QQ Open Platform AppID - 
 QQ APP SECRET QQ Open Platform AppSecret -

install.title: Installation
install.html:
1. Clone the repository

    git clone https://github.com/yincongcyincong/MuseBot.git
cd MuseBot

  2. Install dependencies

     go mod tidy

  3. Set up environment variables

     export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN="your_telegram_bot_token"
 export DEEPSEEK_TOKEN="your_deepseek_api_key"
